notes.title: Demo Timer Removed – You Asked, We Listened!
notes.content:
The demo timer is gone. For good.
A lot of players asked for it, and we totally get it — a timer in a board game doesn’t exactly scream "chill time with your friends" So we went back, looked at the feedback, and said "screw that"

No more countdown. No more pressure. You can try Board Game Society as much as you like, whenever you like. Whether you're solo testing mechanics or pulling a friend in for a match, it's all fully available, no strings attached.

So feel free to explore the board, find little secrets, and experience an early snippet of what's to come. 


Thanks for all the feedback, now give us even more!
We’re incredibly grateful for everyone who took the time to play and share their thoughts. It really helps shape where we go next. And to make it even easier, we've added a FEEDBACK button in the pause menu, while playing the game so you can quickly and easily give us your feedback on the go. 



Give it another go if you’ve been waiting — or tell a friend that the time limit’s no longer a thing.

Thanks again for being part of this with us.
– The Jetebra Games team

notes.title: We Want To Hear Your Ideas!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!
We’re thrilled to share the first public demo of Board Game Society with you during Steam Next Fest! 🎉

This is a big milestone for us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.


🎲 Tried the demo? Help shape the game!
We’re looking for your thoughts, ideas, and bug reports. 

Whether it’s a clever mechanic you loved or something that felt off. 

We want to know.


💬 Best way to reach us? Join our Discord!
That’s where we’re most active, and you’ll get the fastest replies. 

Plus, it’s a great place to chat with fellow fans and follow our development journey.

Additionally, you can also use the voice channels to play with voiceover.


Join our Discord

👉 Second best way? Steam Discussions!
You can also post in the Steam Discussions if you prefer, 

just know it might take us a bit longer to reply there.



Thanks for being part of this first step with us. 

We’re so excited to see your reactions!



// Jetebra Games
